name: python-config-precedence
title: Python layered configuration
blurb: Layered configuration that can answer 'why is the port 9200 in prod?': a schema table, defaults < TOML file < environment < --set flags, provenance for every value, every problem reported in one run, secrets masked until asked for, and a --strict gate that fails when a secret is still the value that shipped with the code
default_description: Layered configuration with provenance, redaction and a strict gate for shipped secrets.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a secret that ships with the code is not a secret
